source_binding_note: The pre-size hashes identify the historical integrated radical/cap input. The size-stage hashes precede final root metadata annotations. All per-glyph after hashes match the current frozen source manifest; glyph geometry did not change during that metadata freeze.
summary: Fit compounds to a shared ink box while keeping simple wholeforms smaller, proportionate and never enlarged. Preserve exact registered component geometry and retain contact-limited exceptions.

policy.contact_limited_exceptions: Limit the fit when needed to preserve existing distinct-path Regular30 contacts and the half-unit safety margin; an exception can remain outside the preferred tier box.
policy.registered_components: A template cohort uses one shared affine profile. Each registered copy retains exact canonical geometry and placement after fitting.

contact_evidence.scope: Distinct complete source paths at Regular30 with a half-unit safety margin. Same-path self-overlap and other weights are outside this guard. Noncontractive affine cases use the explicit distance-monotonicity proof instead of claiming an unexecuted pair check.

noncontractive_hypotheses.whole_glyph: The same positive diagonal affine map applies to every path. Both scale factors are at least one, so every complete-centerline point-pair distance cannot decrease; common translation does not change distances.
noncontractive_hypotheses.shared_component: The template map and composed remainder map are each noncontractive within their own path partitions. All 3,763 component-to-remainder distances are independently measured and required to remain at least 35 font units.
noncontractive_hypotheses.constant_pen: Regular uses an unchanged 30-unit round pen. Distance preservation therefore preserves the distinct-path ink-contact and half-unit-margin thresholds.
noncontractive_hypotheses.floating_point_policy: Scale comparisons treat differences within 1e-6 of one as numerical equality. Exact affine values are retained in each glyph record.

contact_evidence.trial_count_note: 61,344 counts actual trial and final pair evaluations. The 32,549 final pairs across 1,108 glyphs are counted once; 10,220 glyphs use the stated noncontractive proof and are not claimed as executed pair checks.

visual_acceptance.findings: The final integrated specimens retain the approved sizing policy: shorter one-line and natural-aspect simple/royal/counting forms read smaller beside the common compound box. Representative narrow/wide compounds retain branches and counters; U3D7B7 keeps the repaired bowl structure. No new visible regression found.

prototype_reconciliation.interpretation: 10,977 final glyphs are byte-identical to the previously accepted sizing prototype. Differences include332 integrated role/cap inputs and19 existing-cohort profile reconciliations. Six representative additional cases, including the largest shifts, were rendered and independently inspected; five of the19 are numerical roundoff only.

visual_acceptance.scope: Representative integrated source specimens, exact source bindings and automated geometry evidence. Compiled-font validation is bound separately.

glyph_record_stage: before_svg_sha256 binds the historical pre-size integrated source; after_svg_sha256 binds current frozen sources. All transforms and contact-proof classifications below describe that one sizing step.
